thread:
maya_support: Heads-up — ACME (acct-acme-prod) reporting persistent 429s and tokens piling up on their dedicated pool. They say requests started queueing ~15m ago. Ticket: https://tickets.redwood/acme/INC-9876 :eyes:

autoscale-bot: Alert: dedicated-pool-acme scaling suppressed (reason="policy_locked") at 1929004320. min_replicas=4, max_replicas=40

lee_oncall: Looking now. Are they on a committed reservation? Could be minReplicas set by reservation policy.

maya_support: Yes, they purchased reserved capacity. Customer says load jumped ~6x after a batch job — should have scaled.

priya_eng_platform: Can you paste the pool description and the allocator logs? Also pinged billing — heard a past-due hold might block scale actions.

maya_support: From support UI:

```
redwoodctl pool describe dedicated-pool-acme
name: dedicated-pool-acme
min_replicas: 4
max_replicas: 40
active_replicas: 4
scaling_state: SUPPRESSED
suppression_reason: billing_hold
```

Response from API when queueing:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"scale suppressed: billing_hold","retry_after":30}
```

zack_runtime: That's interesting — autoscaler reports suppression_reason=billing_hold, not just unready nodes. If billing service flagged the account we don't allow scale beyond committed baseline.

lee_oncall: Repro steps I ran:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <acct-token>" -d '{"prompt":"x"}'
2) saw 429 with body above
3) ran `redwoodctl pool scale --to 10 dedicated-pool-acme --dry-run` -> returns error: "scale blocked: billing_hold"

priya_eng_platform: Ok assigning owners: @zack_runtime to confirm autoscaler behavior, @maya_support to coordinate with billing + CS. I'll add a temporary mitigation: create an override to force scale up for 30m if customer OK.

zack_runtime: Confirmed: autoscaler checks account state (billing service) and will refuse to increase beyond reservation. There's a race where billing_hold flag wasn't surfaced to CS earlier. I'll open a short-lived override API: `redwoodctl pool override --force-scale 10 --ttl 1800 dedicated-pool-acme` — requires platform-admin perms.

maya_support: Billing cleared invoice at 1929006900 (see billing ticket BL-455). After clearance I triggered the override and pool spun up new replicas.

autoscale-bot: Event: pool-scaling: from=4 to=12 at 1929007200 by=priya_eng_platform (override)

maya_support: Customer reports latency back to normal, 429s stopped ~5m after scale. Customer happy, asked for post-mortem.

priya_eng_platform: Follow-ups: (1) Add visibility for 'billing_hold' in support UI; (2) rework autoscaler to return distinct error code to API so clients can retry differently; (3) create runbook for forced override flow. I'll create tasks in ENG-PLAT board.

lee_oncall: Recording: root cause = billing_hold suppressing scale beyond committed baseline during surge. Temporary fix = admin override + billing clearance. Owner: priya_eng_platform. Closing thread after PO confirms BL-455 resolved. :white_check_mark:
